lines.text: The Ghost Primus was strong because of his disfigurement, not in spite of it. He alone had the vision to share my dream of a new, perfect world. Ghaul was a creature of singular beauty, and I loved him.

lines.text: Did Ghaul always dream of a republic? What terrible worm burrowed into his heart that he would betray my love and plot against me?
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: At the edge of the universe, I stared into the infinite deep. It stared back, and was pleased. I would become the herald of its victory, and bear witness for all creation.

lines.text: Seals are collections of Triumphs. When completed, Seals give you a title that appears above your head. Seals are accessible from the Triumphs tab.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Some activities, like raids and Nightfalls, require you to play with friends. You can use Guided Games to find teams willing to help you get through an activity.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Champions are a new class of combatant, available to fight in Nightfall: The Ordeal, Nightmare Hunts, and other high-end activities. Each Champion is very challenging to defeat without the correct mod installed on a weapon.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Unstoppable Champions will constantly chase you and attack, unless they are stunned by a Seasonal stagger mod.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Barrier Champions will summon an unbreakable shield at low health. While shielded, they will quickly regenerate health. The only way to stop this is to pierce the shield with Seasonal barrier mods.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Overload Champions will constantly regenerate their health and use their special abilities, unless they have been disrupted by a weapon equipped with one of the Seasonal disruption mods.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Ghost can help you pinpoint the location of some hidden objects or points of interest. Listen for the noise he makes, and look for the Ghost icon in the top right corner of the screen. When you take Ghost out, he will also look toward the object's location.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Badges are earned when collecting all gear and cosmetics associated with a particular theme. Collections are accessed on the Collections tab. You need to collect the gear from only one class to earn the badge, so why not start today?
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The Collections tab is where you can view every weapon, piece of armor, emblem, shader, Sparrow, Ghost, and any other cosmetic you've ever acquired. Most can be reacquired for a small cost from the Collections, in case you dismantled it.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Each Season has a related artifact, available on your character screen. Earning experience in a Season ranks up the artifact, allowing you to purchase Seasonal artifact mods.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Increasing the Masterwork tier costs Glimmer, Legendary Shards, Enhancement Cores, Enhancement Prisms, and Ascendant Shards. The cores and shards can be purchased from Banshee-44 or earned in various activities.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Each armor piece starts with a random Masterwork tier, which controls the number and cost of mods installed on it. Increasing the tier becomes more expensive each time.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Banshee-44 has new armor mods for sale every day. Stop by and check out his selection to fill out your collection!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Triumphs are bite-sized records of your achievements. They can be related to your character, specific destinations, activities, lore discoveries, and more.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: : Perform finisher on most low-health combatants. A combatant begins to glow when it's damaged enough to be vulnerable to your finisher.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: A Guardian's resilience stat determines how much damage they can sustain before dying. High resilience is particularly advantageous in the Crucible!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Gaining recovery increases the speed at which you regenerate health.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Gaining discipline increases the speed at which your grenade ability recharges.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Gaining strength increases the speed at which your melee ability rechanges.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Armor and weapons can be infused with other similar pieces of gear, gaining the Power level of the infused piece of gear, for the cost of one Upgrade Module. Upgrade Modules are available for purchase from Banshee-44 and are often available from the Season Pass.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Intelligence on armor affects how quickly your Super ability recharges.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Struggling to make a jump? Equipping armor with a high mobility stat can give you the extra lift you need to reach difficult places.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Some mods are energy-aligned and can be installed only on armor that has the correct energy type. Pay attention to the energy type before you invest in a piece of armor.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: : Use when your Super bar is full to perform a powerful ability.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Every Guardian has a class ability. Look in your character menu for a description and how to activate it!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: If you track certain quests in the quest menu, a green icon helps guide you to the correct destination on the Director.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Unsure what to do next? Look in your quest menu for your next objective!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Past campaign missions for the Red War, Curse of Osiris, and Warmind are available for pickup from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Did you know public events have Heroic versions? During a public event, look for ways to trigger the Heroic version for extra XP and loot! You can find public events on any destination map.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Interacting with an icon on a destination map will unlock an in-world waypoint that can help you navigate to your destination.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Struggling to make that jump? Try changing your jump style within your subclass or equipping armor with a high mobility stat.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: As a Guardian, you have access to multiple subclasses. Experiment with different play styles in your character menu!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Glimmer is the core in-game currency in Destiny. Use it to purchase bounties, items, and upgrades!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Each weapon uses either Primary, Special, or Heavy ammunition. Each ammo type is represented by white, green, or purple ammo bricks in the world.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Raise your Power level by equipping new weapons and armor of a higher level. Higher Power makes you stronger and can even unlock more activities.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Vendors have new weekly bounties each week. They take a decent chunk of time to complete, but offer substantial rewards.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Bounties are a strong source of experience for gaining Season Pass and Artifact levels. Bounties are available for purchase from many Tower vendors as well as your planetary contacts.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Weekly and repeatable bounties sold by Commander Zavala, Lord Shaxx, the Drifter, and others offer Bright Dust as a completion reward. Bright Dust can be used in the Eververse store on weekly rotating items.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Commander Zavala, Lord Shaxx, and the Drifter offer shaders and emblems each Season, achievable through focused investment in their respective activities.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Commander Zavala, Lord Shaxx, and the Drifter offer themed cosmetic upgrades each Season, achievable through focused investment in their respective activites.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: After you reach a certain Power level on your gear, most activities and items no longer grant you progress. A consistent way to advance is to complete weekly challenges that award powerful loot.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Weekly challenges show up with a special icon in the Director. They offer significant experience gains as well as powerful or pinnacle rewards.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Repeatable bounties are expensive, but offer players the ability to earn consistent experience and other rewards that focus on one activity. You can hold only five repeatable bounties from a given vendor at once.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Exotic quests are challenging pursuits that award unique and powerful weapons. Many Exotic quests can be started from vendors in the Tower, but others must be discovered in the world.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Each week, one destination is highlighted by a Flashpoint. During the Flashpoint, you can earn a powerful reward for completing Lost Sectors, public events, and Heroic adventures.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: You can hover over a piece of gear and press  to see a stats comparison between that piece of gear and what you currently have equipped. This works for items in your inventory, vault, or at the postmaster!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Aiming down sights while crouching behind cover allows players to peek over the edge of their firing position and return fire to nearby combatants.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The same weapon can roll with different perks. Try them all to see which perk is right for you!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Snapshot! Having a high handling stat on a weapon allows players to swap and stow weapons more quickly, as well as aim down sights faster.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Abilities with the suppression effect stop targets from using their abilities. Time it right, and you can even stop opposing Guardian Supers in PvP!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The range stat of a weapon determines its accuracy, aim assist, and damage falloff over distance. Higher range can mean the difference between life and death!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Lord Shaxx is your primary contact for the Crucible. He offers bounties you can complete during Crucible matches as well as a weekly challenge that requires bounty completion.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Commander Zavala is your primary contact for Vanguard strikes and Nightfall: The Ordeal. He offers bounties that can be completed during strikes as well as a weekly challenge that requires bounty completion.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Ada-1 in the Tower Annex is your contact for Black Armory forges. She offers quests, challenges, and bounties to help you forge new gear.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The Tower's Cryptarch, Master Rahool, is happy to decrypt any Prime engrams you find. He can also help you dismantle shaders in bulk.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Xûr, Agent of the Nine, sells a rotating selection of Exotic weapons and armor. He sets up shop in a different place each week and is available from Friday to Monday. Keep an eye out!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Kadi 55-30 is the Tower postmaster. Any gear or items you cannot pick up will be available through her.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Suraya Hawthorne offers bounties and raid challenges for clans. She also offers rewards for gaining clan XP and completing activities with your clan. Join a clan and visit Suraya to get started!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Banshee-44, the Vanguard gunsmith, offers weekly, daily, and repeatable bounties that require different weapons from your arsenal. He also offers a weekly challenge to complete these bounties.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The Vault is where you store all the gear and items you don't have room for. Your vault is always available in the Tower, and your gear remains safe and sound.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The Drifter is your primary contact for Gambit and Gambit Prime. He offers bounties you can complete during Gambit and Gambit Prime matches as well as a weekly challenge that requires bounty completion.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Legacy campaigns are available from Amanda Holliday in the Tower Hangar.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Benedict 99-40 in the Tower is your connection to Calus. Visit him for information on Treasure Hunt bounties and all things Menagerie.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: The Spider, boss of the Tangled Shore, runs a black market for most currencies. Visit him today if you're short of destination materials or Legendary shards!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Seasonal events are free to all players! All you have to do is speak to Eva Levante in the Tower during the Seasonal events.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Shaders change the color and material of your armor and weaponry. You can find unique shaders throughout the Destiny universe. Keep an eye out for your favorites.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Gain experience to earn Season Pass ranks and new rewards. You can view a schedule of rewards on the Season Pass page in the Director.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: There are a number of region chests hidden on each destination. Explore and find all of them!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: When you spawn, you are briefly surrounded by your selected transmat effect. You can change your transmat effect on your ship's detail screen. New transmat effects are available from Eververse.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Sparrows allow you to travel quickly across destinations. The higher the top speed, the better! Pay attention to useful perks like instant summoning.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Patrols are simple activities you can undertake while visiting a destination. You might be asked to defeat enemies, collect materials, visit a location, or track down a high-value target.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Universal ornaments can be applied only to Legendary armor that has an energy cost on it. Players can inspect these armor pieces and, on the Appearance page, equip the ornament.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Ships are how you get from destination to destination. New ships can be acquired from many different sources. You can show off your ship to your fireteam while in orbit.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Certain Ghost Shells provide useful benefits. Certain Shells can cause increased experience gain, increased Glimmer drops, and increased tracking range for treasure chests and planetary materials.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Each destination has its own unique planetary materials. These materials can be collected and used to purchase Upgrade Modules. Planetary materials can also be turned in to vendors for reputation gains.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Each destination has secrets to find for rewards. Hunt down Jade Rabbit figurines, find Warmind nodes, or discover hidden cat statues. You never know what you might find!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Ghost projections are display images visible to everyone when you take your Ghost out. New projections are available for purchase from Eververse.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Download the Destiny Companion App to move weapons, visit the forums, and more.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Have multiple platforms? Enable Cross Save on bungie.net/CrossSave and take your main characters with you anywhere.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Follow @BungieHelp on Twitter for the latest information on known issues or service outages.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Visit help.bungie.net for information on known issues impacting Destiny 2, troubleshooting recommendations, and guides on Destiny 2 events, features, and other content.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Are you getting error codes or being disconnected from the game? The Network Troubleshooting Guide on help.bungie.net can help you troubleshoot issues and optimize your connection to Destiny.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Read all about the latest developments in Destiny. Subscribe to Destiny News on bungie.net and never miss out!
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: You can read the lastest blog articles about Destiny on bungie.net.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: Visit the #Help forums on bungie.net to get help from other players, volunteer community moderators, and Destiny Player Support.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: In need of a fireteam, but none of your friends are on? You can locate other players in Find Fireteam, available on bungie.net or the Companion App.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: You can chat with everyone in your current space by using /l (for "local"). If you're in the public or social space, that will include everyone on your roster page.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: By supporting our fellow Guardians, we support humanity's survival.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: When we witness greatness, we spread the word so that others can marvel in it with us.
lines.speaker: Cutscene

lines.text: We watch. We learn. We improve.
lines.speaker: Cutscene
